<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#182828"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0b1212"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="panel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#344646"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="car" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#879c9a"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#465858"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#172121"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="7" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".65"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".55"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif">
    <text x="19" y="20" font-size="13" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <rect x="326" y="11" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="331" y="9" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="336" y="7" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="343" y="10" width="16" height="9" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <rect x="360" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="311" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="306" y1="19" x2="316" y2="19" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <line x1="20" y1="47" x2="34" y2="47" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="53" x2="34" y2="53" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="59" x2="34" y2="59" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="58" font-family="Nobile, sans-serif" font-size="20" letter-spacing="2">Mercedes-Benz</text>
    <circle cx="354" cy="52" r="16" fill="#465454" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="48" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="354" cy="59" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- vehicle status -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="20" y="91" font-size="14" fill="#AAB9B8">MY VEHICLE</text>
    <text x="20" y="116" font-family="Nobile, sans-serif" font-size="26">EQE 350 4MATIC</text>
    <g transform="translate(282 92)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="88" height="28" rx="14" fill="#728887"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="5" fill="#B7F4C7"/>
      <text x="28" y="19" font-size="12">Connected</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- vehicle visualization card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="137" width="358" height="244" rx="29" fill="#0c1515" stroke="#465454" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="327" rx="132" ry="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".7"/>
    <!-- vehicle body -->
    <polygon points="91,289 106,238 137,204 177,187 251,190 287,212 310,267 320,289 302,314 89,314" fill="url(#car)" stroke="#B9C8C6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="132,207 177,190 245,193 276,215 253,235 145,235" fill="#1B292A" stroke="#AFC0BE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="178" y1="192" x2="177" y2="234" stroke="#819695" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="244" y1="195" x2="251" y2="234" stroke="#819695" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="145,239 256,239 270,265 130,265" fill="#526363" opacity=".72"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="267" x2="271" y2="267" stroke="#D5DFDD" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="98" y="284" width="218" height="22" rx="10" fill="#273636"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="301" r="19" fill="#111919" stroke="#9EAFAE" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="284" cy="301" r="19" fill="#111919" stroke="#9EAFAE" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="301" r="8" fill="#435252"/>
    <circle cx="284" cy="301" r="8" fill="#435252"/>
    <line x1="110" y1="279" x2="103" y2="266" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="301" y1="279" x2="309" y2="266" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="251" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="239" x2="195" y2="263" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="251" x2="207" y2="251" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- vehicle info -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="25" y="405" font-size="15">Vehicle status</text>
    <text x="25" y="426" font-size="13" fill="#AAB9B8">Last updated just now</text>
    <g transform="translate(287 394)" filter="url(#soft)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="78" height="38" rx="19" fill="#728887"/>
      <text x="20" y="24" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Connect</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- range cards -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="20" y="449" width="168" height="72" rx="23" fill="#465454"/>
    <rect x="202" y="449" width="168" height="72" rx="23" fill="#465454"/>
    <text x="36" y="472" fill="#AAB9B8" font-size="12">BATTERY</text>
    <text x="36" y="501" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="23" font-weight="600">78%</text>
    <rect x="105" y="490" width="62" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#1E2929"/>
    <rect x="105" y="490" width="48" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#B7F4C7"/>
    <text x="218" y="472" fill="#AAB9B8" font-size="12">EST. RANGE</text>
    <text x="218" y="501" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="23" font-weight="600">286 mi</text>
  </g>

  <!-- controls section -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="20" y="556" font-size="17" font-weight="600">Quick controls</text>
    <text x="318" y="556" font-size="13" fill="#7EC0F6">Edit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- circular controls -->
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" filter="url(#soft)">
    <circle cx="62" cy="600" r="29" fill="#728887"/>
    <circle cx="151" cy="600" r="29" fill="#465454"/>
    <circle cx="240" cy="600" r="29" fill="#465454"/>
    <circle cx="329" cy="600" r="29" fill="#465454"/>
    <!-- AC icon -->
    <text x="62" y="606" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="16" font-weight="600">AC</text>
    <!-- lights icon -->
    <circle cx="143" cy="600" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="592" x2="126" y2="588" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="600" x2="124" y2="600" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="608" x2="126" y2="612" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="592" x2="166" y2="588" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="600" x2="168" y2="600" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="608" x2="166" y2="612" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- parking -->
    <text x="240" y="607" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="19" font-weight="600">P</text>
    <circle cx="240" cy="600" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- lock -->
    <rect x="320" y="598" width="18" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="324,598 324,592 334,592 334,598" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="62" y="646" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="13">AC</text>
    <text x="151" y="646" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="13">Lights</text>
    <text x="240" y="646" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="13">Parking</text>
    <text x="329" y="646" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="13">Doors</text>
  </g>

  <!-- lower status strip -->
  <g filter="url(#soft)" font-family="Inter, sans-serif">
    <rect x="20" y="672" width="350" height="62" rx="23" fill="#253333"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="703" r="17" fill="#728887"/>
    <polygon points="49,692 52,700 60,700 54,705 56,713 49,708 42,713 44,705 38,700 46,700" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="77" y="698" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Engine ready</text>
    <text x="77" y="718" fill="#AAB9B8" font-size="12">All systems operating normally</text>
    <circle cx="341" cy="703" r="5" fill="#B7F4C7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#070B0B"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#465454" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g font-family="Inter, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">
    <!-- home -->
    <g transform="translate(39 774)">
      <polygon points="0,9 12,0 24,9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="5" y="9" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="12" y="42" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- vehicle selected -->
    <g transform="translate(117 774)">
      <rect x="0" y="5" width="28" height="16" rx="7" fill="#728887"/>
      <line x1="5" y1="5" x2="9" y2="0" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="23" y1="5" x2="19" y2="0" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="7" cy="21" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="21" cy="21" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="14" y="42" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11">Vehicle</text>
    </g>
    <!-- activity -->
    <g transform="translate(202 774)">
      <circle cx="13" cy="10" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="13,4 13,11 18,14" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="13" y="42" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11">Activity</text>
    </g>
    <!-- account -->
    <g transform="translate(290 774)">
      <circle cx="13" cy="7" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="13" cy="19" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="13" y="42" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11">Account</text>
    </g>
    <!-- support -->
    <g transform="translate(357 774)">
      <circle cx="13" cy="11" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="13" y="16" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="13" font-weight="600">?</text>
      <text x="13" y="42" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11">Help</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
